subject.declared_domain: The NEGATIVE declaration of the C1 vocabulary: eight physical edge_types stated NOT to be relations, each carrying the axis it serves instead and, where applicable, the role it assigns. It exists so that an edge the graph emits but the relation vocabulary does not name is a DECLARED exclusion rather than an unexplained gap.

methodology.how: A hand-legislated YAML block, top-level key `non_relation_edges:` at line 155. Eight members keyed by the PHYSICAL edge_type (MONITORS, SHARES_SOURCE, ENCRYPTS_WITH, IS_ENDPOINT, DECLARES, INSTANTIATES, REFERENCES_TYPE, HAS_TYPE) -- note the keys are UPPER_SNAKE physical names, the inverse of #relations whose keys are agnostic English. Each member carries `axis` (which orthogonal axis the edge serves, e.g. ROLE) and, for some, `assigns` (the role it confers, e.g. MONITORS -> Observer).
declared_opinions: The judgement that these eight are NOT relations is the block's entire content and it has no stated derivation. MONITORS assigns Observer and is excluded from the relation vocabulary; TRIGGERS is included. Nothing states the test that separates them.

DECLARES, INSTANTIATES, REFERENCES_TYPE and HAS_TYPE are excluded as the definitional/taxonomy axis (D8) -- consistent with scope_outs excluding Type/Symbol/Concept, so the exclusion is at least coherent across two blocks.
The block is a WHITELIST of exclusions, not a rule. A ninth non-relation edge would be silently treated as an unnamed gap until someone adds it by hand.

verdict.why: All seven rows worked with basis/evidence/owner; not INCOMPLETE. This is the healthiest of my six rule-bank blocks: 8 of 8 members are live, the two copies are byte-identical for it, its key space needs no bridge, and its exclusions are coherent with scope_outs. QUALIFIED rather than SOUND on three limits: (1) the judgement separating a non-relation from a relation has NO stated test -- MONITORS is excluded and TRIGGERS is not, and nothing says why, so the block cannot be extended without re-deriving someone's reasoning; (2) it is a hand-maintained whitelist, so a ninth non-relation edge reads as a gap until someone notices; (3) the silent-None lookup miss, exercised. NOT CLAIMED: that the eight exclusions are correct. NO DEPRECATION VERDICT, per W2-m-3.
